title: Public daily source audit rollback
summary: This iteration rolls back the public daily source-first runtime surface after the 2026-06-29 page became dominated by source audit dashboards, inventory rows, and system-style operating logs. The fix restores story-first public daily output, keeps source-first sections behind an explicit internal diagnostic mode, removes dormant source-inventory runtime assets from public pages, and regenerates affected public artifacts.

validation_commands: node --test --test-name-pattern "public daily reports do not render source-first audit panels before story content" tests/unit.test.js

node --test --test-name-pattern "effective-interact renders source inventory finder|effective-interact generator creates|public daily reports do not render source-first" tests/skills.test.js tests/unit.test.js
Playwright desktop/mobile visual check for docs/reports/2026/06/2026-06-29.html at 1365x900 and 390x844

lessons.lesson: Source health proof is not the same thing as public daily content.
lessons.evidence: The polluted public page rendered source dashboards, inventory groups, and system metrics ahead of the daily stories; the restored page starts with story sections and has zero source audit section ids.
lessons.recommended_action: Keep source-first runtime sections excluded from public daily pages by default and require an explicit internal diagnostic flag for future use.

lessons.lesson: Public generated data must not carry runtime display/status fields that only exist to support internal source dashboards.
lessons.evidence: The public data projection now strips display_section, display_rank, display_mode, and status_label fields while private reports-data remains available for internal checks.
lessons.recommended_action: Bind future public data additions to reader-facing rendering needs rather than internal operating dashboards.

lessons.lesson: Renderer assets should be conditional when a capability is internal or optional.
lessons.evidence: Effective-interact now emits source inventory finder CSS and JavaScript only when the rendered interaction actually contains a source inventory finder section.
lessons.recommended_action: Keep optional diagnostic widgets behind section-presence checks so public pages do not accumulate invisible runtime machinery.

suggestions.issue: The public daily page was dominated by source-first audit and operations panels instead of reader-facing AI daily stories.
suggestions.evidence: Diagnosis traced the regression to source-first runtime sections inserted by default into public interaction input and then enforced by tests and the source display contract.
suggestions.module: src/interaction-report.js, src/site.js, src/page-checklist.js, tests/unit.test.js, tests/e2e/site.e2e.js, config/source-display-contract.json, .codex/skills/effective-interact/scripts/create-interaction.mjs
suggestions.suggestion: Make source-first runtime sections an explicit internal diagnostic mode and assert that public daily pages exclude source audit panels by default.
suggestions.expected_benefit: Public daily pages return to compact story scanning while internal source governance can still be inspected when deliberately requested.
suggestions.promotion_path: Implemented through interaction-input gating, public data minimization, page-check changes, unit/e2e regression coverage, contract documentation, regenerated public artifacts, and desktop/mobile visual verification.

followups.action: Before the next daily-page iteration, decide whether any source-health summary belongs in public output at all, and if so keep it compact, reader-facing, and below the main story sections.
